acceptance: Completed or imported native ED2K shared files are visible to the daemon sharing service when sharing is enabled.

acceptance: The daemon can accept a local ED2K upload request and serve only verified shared ranges through the native upload queue.
evidence: RED failed because no daemon TCP upload service existed. GREEN starts a native ED2K TCP upload listener when sharing is enabled, accepts peer hello and StartUploadRequest, serves requested verified ranges from the native shared store, and rejects non-shared files through upload queue truth.
notes: No chat preview collection or GUI behavior.

acceptance: The daemon can answer local UDP reask requests from current native upload queue state.
evidence: RED failed because no daemon UDP reask service existed. GREEN starts a native ED2K UDP listener when sharing is enabled and answers ReaskFilePing from current upload queue state with truthful ReaskAck, FileNotFound, or QueueFull frames.
